source_evidence: Exact player 'Give her 500 gold as a startup investment, and tell her to go ahead and start the work getting the repairs, contracts, and mine up and running.' At D338~12:10 V physically transfers exactly500gp from personal purse2020gp8sp6cp to Hessa Marr's custody as separate Silverward startup capital; V purse1520gp8sp6cp. No second charge for this same investment or automatic transfer to a different estate. Hessa accepts the funded operating mandate and is authorized to obtain and accept reasonable professional quotes, engage qualified craftsmen and mining surveyor/assayer, repair and fit out the service-house after appropriate structural safety checks, establish modest safe lodging/meals/feed/tethering/storage and actively pursue, follow up, negotiate and fulfill commercially viable customer contracts as capacity becomes available. For the mine, discreetly arrange site survey, assay, flood/structural assessment, access/parcel and lawful mineral-rights verification, feasibility and extraction plans, and begin safe development/operation if rights, technical and economic prerequisites are satisfied, within available funding. No need for routine V signoff inside mandate; no borrowing, additional V funds, forced resident/ferry rights transfer, unverified mineral title, unfunded obligations, major expansion beyond available capital or unsafe extraction. Hessa begins arranging contact with her known mason and mining specialist today, using her local contacts, with first actual quotes, acceptance and visits yet to be resolved. Existing 50–70gp provisional service-house estimate and pending survey quote are not incurred expenses. Existing agreed stewardship wage5gp/actual day and voluntary guardians retained. data/estate/README.md latest run D337-ESTATE confirms separate Silverward account and overdue15gp D334 payroll pending lawful funding; Hessa is authorized to settle already verified payroll from the new funds, but no actual payout yet adjudicated. Six completed days D332–337 total30gp earned per prior accepted report; reconcile against existing owner journal, never repost prior wage accruals or earlier outreach, D338 remains open. No new contract, worker engagement, actual payment beyond V's 500gp capital transfer, inspection, construction, sales, revenue, or mine production claimed. Hessa to continue active daily outreach and follow-through and report material costs, results and setbacks; start work now, not wait for more ordinary approvals. No roll required for voluntary acceptance and actual authorized transfer. Prior Hessa independent home/ferry rights, conditional service-house grant, guardian arrangements, all other estate accounts/quest/custody unchanged.
